source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Once during each opponent turn, you may relocate the Yncarne on the battlefield immediately after you lose another **AELDARI** unit. Place it as near as you can to the last casualty’s position, outside enemy **[Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)**. This relocation leaves the Yncarne’s eligibility to move intact.

detail.trigger: just after another friendly AELDARI unit is destroyed in opponent turn
